[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#decision-summary]

## Decision Summary

Gainwell adopts **forward-only change propagation** and **agent-execution idempotency** as the maintenance-edge governance of the agentic SDLC: a change to a shipped artifact is never applied by reopening the completed work item — it emits a **new, superseding work item** with a provenance chain — and an autonomous agent **never redundantly executes work that has already shipped**, no-op-ing with provenance instead. This ADR is the decision anchor for the mandatory controls in STD-GOV-AI-004 and the traceability amendments in STD-GOV-AI-003.

---
page_texts.5:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#context-and-problem-statement]

## Context and Problem Statement

- **Business Context**: With autonomous agents executing work in parallel and continuously, two runtime failure modes emerged that corrupt the auditable record of "what was built": (1) reopening a shipped work item to apply a change makes the delivery lifecycle non-monotonic and destroys the append-only audit trail; (2) an agent re-dispatched for a deliverable that already shipped either duplicates it or improvises, producing redundant PRs and non-deterministic "complete-with-no-PR" records.
- **Technical Context**: The pipeline binds each shipped implementation to its governing spec version via a Built-From stamp (SemVer + merge-commit anchor). A post-go-live change therefore has two possible responses — mutate the closed item, or emit a new one — and the pipeline must decide idempotency *before* dispatch, not after an agent has run.
- **Problem Statement**: Without a ratified decision, teams reopen closed issues (losing the audit trail) and agents redundantly execute already-satisfied work (wasting runs and corrupting completion records). On one exemplar project this produced ~45 wasted agent executions and ~30 non-deterministic COMPLETED-no-PR records. There is no enterprise decision or standard governing either behavior.
page_texts.6:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#decision-drivers]

### Decision Drivers

- 📋 **Audit-trail integrity (HIPAA/CMS)** — the record of what was built, from which spec version, must be append-only and monotonic.
- ⚡ **Deterministic autonomous execution** — parallel agents must not duplicate or improvise on already-shipped work.
- 💰 **Cost** — redundant agent executions are direct waste.
- 📋 **Consistency with the operating model** — ADR-GOV-011 makes change a first-class axis; this ADR governs how change propagates without breaking traceability.

---
page_texts.8:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#forward-only-propagation--pre-dispatch-idempotency--no-op-with-provenance]

### Forward-Only Propagation + Pre-Dispatch Idempotency + No-Op-With-Provenance

**Description**: Adopt three inseparable rules keyed on a **universal deliverable stable-ID**:

- **Forward-only propagation** — a change to a shipped artifact emits a NEW superseding work item carrying a `Supersedes:` / `Built-From` chain (SemVer + merge-commit anchor); the completed work item is never reopened.
- **Pre-dispatch idempotency gate** — before dispatching, the pipeline resolves the incoming work item's deliverable stable-ID; if a sibling with the same stable-ID already shipped (closed-completed with resolved provenance), it does NOT dispatch — it labels `agent:duplicate`, comments `superseded by #<canonical>`, and closes not-planned.
- **No-op-with-provenance** — an agent that finds its named deliverable already fully built no-ops citing the canonical artifact/PR rather than improvising; a genuinely partial deliverable proceeds; ambiguity halts to loopback.

**Phase 1**: Define the universal stable-ID and the Built-From/Supersedes chain (STD-GOV-AI-003 amendments).

**Phase 2**: Mandate the three idempotency controls (STD-GOV-AI-004) and the `agent:duplicate` label (STD-GOV-AI-002).

**Pros**:

- ✅ Preserves an append-only, monotonic audit trail — no reopened lifecycles.
- ✅ Eliminates redundant agent executions and non-deterministic completion records.
- ✅ Keys everything on the full stable-ID, so distinct layers/screens of one contract are never wrongly collapsed as duplicates.

**Cons**:

- ❌ Requires a reliable universal stable-ID and Built-From chain to exist first.
- ❌ Superseding-issue chains are longer to read than an in-place edit history.

---
page_texts.10:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#option-1-reopen-and-edit-shipped-work-items]

### Option 1: Reopen-and-edit shipped work items

**Description**: Apply a post-go-live change by reopening the closed issue and re-running the agent.

**Pros**:

- ✅ Fewer work items; the change lives on the original item.

**Cons**:

- ❌ Non-monotonic lifecycle destroys the append-only audit trail (a compliance problem).
- ❌ Re-running against a mutated spec loses the Built-From binding to the version that actually shipped.
page_texts.11:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#option-2-post-hoc-duplicate-cleanup-no-pre-dispatch-gate]

### Option 2: Post-hoc duplicate cleanup (no pre-dispatch gate)

**Description**: Let agents execute, then detect and close duplicates afterward.

**Pros**:

- ✅ Simpler dispatch logic.

**Cons**:

- ❌ The waste (redundant runs) and the non-deterministic completion records have already happened before cleanup.
- ❌ Cleanup heuristics are error-prone without a stable-ID identity.
page_texts.12:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#option-3-leave-as-pipeline-implementation-detail-no-enterprise-decision]

### Option 3: Leave as pipeline implementation detail (no enterprise decision)

**Description**: Let each project's pipeline decide.

**Pros**:

- ✅ No governance overhead.

**Cons**:

- ❌ Inconsistent, unauditable behavior across teams; a compliance auditor cannot rely on any invariant.
- ❌ This is the status quo that produced the quantified waste and record corruption.

---
page_texts.13:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#decision-outcome]

## Decision Outcome

**Chosen Option**: **Forward-Only Propagation + Pre-Dispatch Idempotency + No-Op-With-Provenance** (Required Option)

**Rationale**: Only the required option preserves an append-only audit trail (rejecting Option 1's non-monotonic reopen) and prevents the waste and record corruption *before* they occur (rejecting Option 2's after-the-fact cleanup and Option 3's inconsistency). It is the maintenance-edge complement to ADR-GOV-011's forward operating model.
page_texts.14:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#implementation]

### Implementation

- 🎯 **Key Steps**: Ratify this ADR; author STD-GOV-AI-004 (the three mandatory idempotency controls); amend STD-GOV-AI-003 (universal stable-ID, Built-From/Supersedes chain, status-on-close, out-of-band detection) and STD-GOV-AI-002 (`agent:duplicate` label).
- 📊 **Success Criteria**: no reopened shipped work items; zero redundant agent executions for already-shipped deliverables; every change traceable through a Supersedes chain; the audit trail is append-only.

---
page_texts.16:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#-positive]

### ✅ Positive

- Append-only, monotonic audit trail across the agentic SDLC.
- Deterministic autonomous execution; no duplicate/improvised work.
- Change is fully traceable via the Supersedes/Built-From chain.
page_texts.17:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#-negative]

### ❌ Negative

- Depends on a reliable universal stable-ID and Built-From chain (delivered by the STD-GOV-AI-003 amendments).
- More work items over time (superseding chains) than an in-place edit model.
page_texts.18:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#-neutral]

### ⚪ Neutral

- Extends, does not replace, the execution model of ADR-GOV-009.
- Applies only to the agentic pipeline; human-only workflows are unaffected unless they adopt it.

---
page_texts.20:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#-risks]

### ⚠️ Risks

- **Over-collapse** — distinct layers/screens of one contract wrongly treated as duplicates.
- **Missing provenance** — a shipped item with an unrecoverable merge SHA can't be matched.
page_texts.21:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#-mitigations]

### 🛡️ Mitigations

- Key idempotency on the **full** stable-ID (concern-feature-layer), never a truncated prefix.
- Use an explicit `@unresolved` provenance anchor when a merge SHA is genuinely unrecoverable, rather than guessing (never fabricate a drift anchor).

---
page_texts.22:
[decisions/governance/ADR-GOV-012-forward-only-change-propagation-and-execution-idempotency.md#compliance-notes]

## Compliance Notes

- **Security**: append-only provenance supports tamper-evident audit.
- **Regulatory**: HIPAA/CMS — a monotonic, superseding-chain record of what was built from which spec version is defensible audit evidence; reopen-and-edit is not.
- **Standards**: this ADR is the decision basis for STD-GOV-AI-004 (idempotency controls) and the STD-GOV-AI-003 / STD-GOV-AI-002 amendments; aligns with ADR-GOV-011 (change as a first-class axis) and ADR-GOV-009 (execution model).

---
